scope: Audit of 33 historical manual NO decisions. Following the PI authorization on 2026-10-26, every group is restored to current main Rust membership; historical choices remain unchanged. This audit prioritizes follow-up, never filters completeness or establishes physical denial.

independent_diagnostics.method: SAP-quality-zero and finite original-view flux/time; each quarter divided by its own positive median, minus one; original period/epoch; 80 uniform full-orbit phase bins with >=3 points; median statistic, no trend removal, no uncertainty or detection-significance claim. This differs from frozen discovery preparation.
